flags.message: Forecast is decisively shaped by pre-snapshot public information outside the docket: certiorari granted June 30, 2026 in Viramontes v. Cook County (No. 25-238), consolidated with Grant v. Higgins (No. 25-566) from the Second Circuit, argument December 2, 2026, on whether AR-15-platform rifles 'in common use' are protected. The petition asks in the alternative to be held for it. I forecast hold-then-GVR as the modal path, which is why P(grant) sits far above the baseline-band anchor (~5%); the band table carries no cut for a call-for-response or a pending-hold state, so that adjustment rests on general practice, not a committed rate.
